description: This file defines a utility class StringUtils with various static methods for string manipulation, including checking for emptiness, trimming, substring extraction, obfuscation, splitting, random string generation, and token creation. It also references external libraries such as Guava, Apache Commons Lang3, and Spring Framework.

classes.name: StringUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for advanced string operations, including checks, modifications, obfuscation, splitting, random string and token generation, and substring extraction.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is null or empty.

methods.name: isBlank
methods.description: Checks if a string is null, empty, or contains only whitespace.

methods.name: isNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is not null and not empty.

methods.name: isNotBlank
methods.description: Checks if a string is not null, not empty, and contains non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: notBlankOrDefault
methods.description: Returns the source string if not blank; otherwise, returns a default string.

methods.name: removeStart
methods.description: Removes the specified prefix from the start of a string if present.

methods.name: substringBefore
methods.description: Returns the substring before the first occurrence of a separator.

methods.name: substringBetween
methods.description: Extracts the substring between two delimiters.

methods.name: obfuscate
methods.description: Obfuscates a portion of a string with a specified character, keeping a margin of visible characters at start and end.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into fixed-length parts using Guava's Splitter.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal, ignoring case.

methods.name: join
methods.description: Joins an array of strings with a specified separator.

methods.name: trimToNull
methods.description: Trims a string and returns null if empty.

methods.name: isNoneEmpty
methods.description: Checks if a string is not null and not empty.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: hasLength
methods.description: Checks if a string has length greater than zero.

methods.name: isNoneBlank
methods.description: Checks if multiple strings are all non-blank.

methods.name: hasText
methods.description: Checks if a string contains non-whitespace characters.

methods.name: defaultString
methods.description: Returns the string or a default value if null.

methods.name: isNumeric
methods.description: Checks if a string contains only digits.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two strings are equal.

methods.name: equalsAny
methods.description: Checks if a string equals any in a list of strings.

methods.name: equalsAnyIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks if a string equals any in a list of strings, ignoring case.

methods.name: substringBeforeLast
methods.description: Returns the substring before the last occurrence of a separator.

methods.name: substringAfterLast
methods.description: Returns the substring after the last occurrence of a separator.

methods.name: containedByAny
methods.description: Checks if a string is contained within any of a list of strings.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a CharSequence contains another CharSequence.

methods.name: contains0x00
methods.description: Checks if a string contains the null byte (0x00).

methods.name: randomNumeric
methods.description: Generates a secure random numeric string of specified length.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Generates a secure random string of specified length.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Generates a secure random string of specified length from given characters.

methods.name: randomAlphanumeric
methods.description: Generates a secure random alphanumeric string.

methods.name: randomAlphabetic
methods.description: Generates a secure random alphabetic string.

methods.name: generateSafeToken
methods.description: Generates a URL-safe base64 encoded token of specified length.

methods.name: generateSafeToken
methods.description: Generates a default length URL-safe base64 encoded token.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string to a maximum length, appending a marker if truncated.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates a string with a custom truncation marker function.

methods.name: splitByCommaWithoutQuotes
methods.description: Splits a comma-separated string into parts, respecting quotes.
